messages:
nina: FYI planning a targeted pin of runtime 5.1.0 -> 5.0.7 for NA cluster during our 23:00-01:00 UTC window. Observed higher tail latency with quant-v5 on 5.1.0 for certain model families.

jack: Targeted pin how? full revert or soft-pin canary?

nina: soft-pin: canary 0.5% -> 5% manual. We'll exclude SDK 4.x clients because 4.x changed keepalive semantics and we don't want them in the canary yet.

deploy-bot: deploy plan created: pin-runtime-5.0.7-na | window 2024-10-10T23:00Z-01:00Z | canary 0.5% -> 5% @20m | predicate: not header('x-sdk').matches('^4\\.')

qa-lee: ran a short stress test: SDK 4.0 + runtime 5.1.0 -> intermittent keepalive timeouts under sustained connections. Repro: open 100 persistent streams for 60s -> ~2% timeouts.

jack: we have header coverage for ~68% of NA traffic. Unknown clients will be excluded by default.

ops: please attach rollback steps; also add release notes mentioning the temporary exclusion so support isn't confused.

nina: rollback runbook: 1) abort canary and revert default pin to 5.1.0 via `deploybot set-default-runtime na 5.1.0` 2) scale canary to 0% 3) clear streaming cache on canary nodes 4) if error rate >0.4% for 5m engage runtime oncall.

docs-amy: I'll add a note to the internal pinlist and draft a short customer-facing blurb: "Customers on SDK v4.x excluded from the initial canary; we'll include them after validation."

deploy-bot: PR for routing predicate opened: github.com/redwood/deploy-rules/pull/612 | contains predicate and unit tests.

qa-lee: monitoring hooks added: stream-timeout alert >0.3% and latency p99 > baseline.

jack: approve proceeding with soft-pin under predicate. Post-canary we will decide whether to include SDK 4.x.

nina: scheduled: canary start 2024-10-10T23:10Z | payload 0.5% | excluded SDK 4.x. Manual approval at 23:30Z to expand.

deploy-bot: canary started at 2024-10-10T23:10Z | 0.5% traffic | excluded header pattern '^4\\.'

qa-lee: first 15m: stream timeouts at 0.08% and p99 latency within baseline. No immediate regressions.

nina: hold for 23:30 manual check; if green expand to 5%.

jack: +1 from infra. Docs amy will publish internal note and CS blurb after expansion.

deploy-bot: canary expanded to 5% at 2024-10-10T23:31Z after manual approval. Monitoring will report back in 10m.
